purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: Eskişehir’s cadastral and title registry offices are confirmed by official TKGM sources. The shared public parcel service is documented, but today’s exact city point response was rate-limited before returning a feature. No property-owner, address or account lookup was submitted. No full geometry sample was retained.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official TKGM Eskişehir Regional Directorate lists Eskişehir Kadastro Müdürlüğü plus central Odunpazarı and Tepebaşı Tapu Müdürlükleri.
Official regional office contact page places TKGM Eskişehir Regional Directorate in Tepebaşı, Eskişehir.

Official TKGM public page describes parcel location, adjacent parcels, area, coordinates and KML/PDF output; its query instructions use parcel locality and block/parcel numbers and explicitly disallow owner-name or Turkish ID queries.
